From: Noreply <noreply-bounces@lists.circular-chart.com> On Behalf Of Marelis Chartering
Sent: Thursday, 26 February 2026 10:33
To: noreply@lists.circular-chart.com
Subject: Re: Firm Spot 7-12k wheat Odesa - EC Italy / READY TO FIX

 

Dear Sirs, 

 

Good day to all,

 

Strictly Not for Recirculation

 

Pls propose workable tonnage for our direct Charterers

 

Firm cargo / READY TO FIX

 

7200 – 12 000 mts of Wheat sf abt 47’ wog
Odesa to EC Italy 
2000x/2000x
Spot - onw
1.25 Add comm + 1.25 for Marelis 

 

Awaiting for the suitable candidates with frt ideas from Owns side 

 

Plsd to hear

 

Kind Regards 

 

Vladislav Datiy

Brokerage Dpt.

Marelis Navigation S.A. 

Mobile: +30 697 255 0514

WhatsApp: +380 95 159 6113

Teams: live:.cid.36a87362b7a2b27e

E-mail: chartering@marelis-nav.com <mailto:chartering@marelis-nav.com> 

 

 

 

This is not a spam or junk mail. It's regular mail of shipping&chartering business. If you are not interested in content of our messages,please send a message with the subject "Unsubscribe" to unsubscribe@marelis-nav.com <mailto:unsubscribe@marelis-nav.com> 



--
